messages:
sam: Quick check on the private setup wizard probe step. When many probes run, the list becomes a long scroll. Thinking: an accordion with compact summary rows vs a grouped card layout. Which helps discovery?

marie: Accordion wins for vertical density, but we need the primary fix action visible. Suggest summary row contains icon + one-line parse + small primary CTA 'Run again' and a chevron to expand logs.

oscar: OK to use 'Run again' as the primary CTA. Also add a tiny kebab menu (⋯) for secondary actions: 'View remediation', 'Copy support snippet', 'Show raw'. Keeps the row clean.

tess: Accessibility: make the chevron a proper button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. The summary row should be focusable as a single tab stop and Enter expands it. Avoid making the whole row a link.

a11y-bot: Note: use a scoped aria-live region for status updates on the summary row (aria-live="polite"). Do not place live on the entire list.

marie: Microcopy: instead of 'agent failed' try 'Connectivity check couldn't complete'. Full help line: 'Connectivity check couldn't complete 94 verify SSH port 22, allowed CIDRs, and any proxy/egress rules.' Short mobile line: 'Can't reach Redwood 94 check SSH 22 & CIDR.'

oscar: For error affordance, use an inline left accent plus an error icon and bold label text. Add an assistive text for colorblind users: 'status: failed' placed visually-hidden but readable by SR.

tess: When a user clicks 'Run again', keep keyboard focus on the button and update the status text in the live region. Only move focus if the user expands details themselves.

a11y-bot: Also ensure that any new actionable element inserted after a run (like 'View remediation') is announced but not auto-focused. Use role=status on the live fragment.

oscar: Idea: a small sticky summary header above the accordion with counts and filter chips: e.g., 'All (12)  Passing (8)  Warning (2)  Failed (2)'. Each chip filters the list and is keyboard-accessible.

marie: Good. UX detail: when filtering, maintain scroll position and highlight the first matching item. We should announce via SR: 'Filtered to Failed probes, 2 items'.

sam: Logs: show parsed summary first and keep raw behind a 'Show raw output' disclosure. The raw block should be preformatted and have a 'Copy raw' button that copies to clipboard.

oscar: Also provide a 'Copy support payload' that creates a short JSON-lite string: probe name, parsed error, last checked, and a short link to docs. This should be clearly labeled and accessible.

tess: Keyboard nav: inside expanded panel, Tabbing cycles through actions then into logs. The logs are scrollable region with tabindex=0 and aria-label='Raw probe output'.

a11y-bot: QA checklist: 1) aria-expanded on chevrons; 2) scoped aria-live on summary rows; 3) focus remains on user-clicked 'Run again'; 4) inserted CTAs announced but not focused; 5) contrast >=4.5:1 for labels; 6) animations respect prefers-reduced-motion.

ux-bot: Mock uploaded: https://figma.com/proto/probe-accordion-xyz (placeholder).

sam: Next actions: Marie update microcopy variants & post PR, Oscar to prototype header counts + filter chips, Tess to draft aria attrs & keyboard flow, I'll add the copy-paste support payload spec. Sync in 20. :thumbsup:
